game_concept: A action defense set in The Kingdom – Chapel Gardens, the chapel gardens: the herald must handle rogue crows while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Uninitialized Hunt: Find variables used before assignment and fix them before rogue crows exploit the gap.
theme: The Kingdom – Chapel Gardens: the chapel gardens
core_gameplay_loop: Read the requested procedure, drag flowchart shapes into the chart, then run checks against example inputs and expected outputs.
player_objective: Protect the castle gate from rogue crows in Chapel Gardens: keep the bugs_fixed meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 38-second timer ends.
controls: Drag blocks from the tray into chart positions. Drag them back to remove them. Check chart runs the algorithm. Keyboard: [ or ] selects a block, arrows choose a position, Enter places, C checks, Escape pauses.
lose_condition: bugs_fixed drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 38-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: CP1 Week 1: Controls and mission practice
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Uninitialized Hunt' (Week 1 slot 15), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Chapel Gardens'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how bugs_fixed changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue crows in Chapel Gardens.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 38 seconds while bugs_fixed > 0.
